summary: Digital marketer with a sales mindset who judges a website by the customers it brings in. At Episto I help client businesses rank for the searches their buyers make, from keyword research and technical SEO to local SEO and link building, and as a freelancer I bring in and scope my own clients. Years as a tango instructor in Türkiye taught me to work with people every day, build trust and take ownership of a whole studio, from the first class of the day to closing. My start in front-end development means I can build a landing page, run a Google Ads campaign and read the data without waiting on anyone. Outside client work I build my own products with AI, from a dog-care app on Google Play to fitness and nutrition trackers, which keeps me close to how real users find, try and stick with a product. I am analytical, I follow search engine algorithm updates closely, and I am eager to learn. I want a commercial team where that ownership turns into more customers.
